candidates.name: Title Number and UPRN Look Up dataset - Technical specification
verified_facts: The dataset links HMLR title numbers to Ordnance Survey AddressBase UPRNs only where an address relationship can be made.
Some titles can have no UPRN in this dataset even where a real-world UPRN exists, and titles affecting many properties can be associated with multiple UPRNs.
Title number is the HMLR identifier used to link to other HMLR datasets.
AddressBase change-only updates are ingested on a six-week cycle and published data reflects the latest matched association.
semantic_limits: Title number and UPRN are not assumed to be one-to-one; a missing or multiple UPRN relationship cannot be used to invent parcel geometry or height.

candidates.name: Title Descriptor dataset - Technical specification
verified_facts: The Title Descriptor dataset provides estate interest and class of title for registered estates and interests in England and Wales.
Each registered estate or interest has a unique title number and one class of title.
An application awaiting registration can have an associated title number while estate interest or class-of-title information is not yet present.
The dataset is maintained with monthly full, change-only and validation outputs.
semantic_limits: Class of title and registered-status evidence are legal registration attributes, not survey accuracy, exact boundary coordinates or terrain elevation.
